name: azure_private_endpoint
description:
Manages an Azure Private Endpoint, giving a PaaS resource a private IP address inside a subnet so it can be reached without traversing the public internet.

The platform does two things per endpoint: it creates the `Microsoft.Network/privateEndpoints` resource, then attaches a Private DNS zone group so the target's public hostname resolves to the private IP from inside the network. The zone is chosen from `sub_resource_name` — `blob` gives `privatelink.blob.core.windows.net`, `vault` gives `privatelink.vaultcore.azure.net`, and so on. The resource only reports Complete once both steps have succeeded, so a Complete endpoint always has working private DNS.

Everything about an endpoint is immutable: Azure has no in-place update for one, and the API rejects the attempt outright. Any change here — including tags — replaces the endpoint.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this private endpoint.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Private endpoint name. Also names the private-link service connection inside it.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment in which the private endpoint is provisioned.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group in which the private endpoint is provisioned. Its Azure resource group is where the endpoint is created unless `azure_resource_group_name` overrides it.

attributes.name: target_resource_arm_id
attributes.description:
Full Azure resource ID (ARM ID) of the PaaS resource the endpoint connects to. Other resources in this provider expose theirs: `duploai_storage_account.azure_resource_id`, `duploai_azure_key_vault.key_vault_id`, `duploai_azure_managed_redis.cluster_id`.

The target must already be provisioned — the API rejects the create otherwise, because Azure needs the resource to exist before a private-link connection can be made to it.

attributes.name: sub_resource_name
attributes.description:
Which part of the target resource the endpoint exposes — Azure calls it the private-link group ID. One endpoint serves one sub-resource, so a storage account needing both blob and file access needs two endpoints.

The value also decides the Private DNS zone the platform attaches:

| `sub_resource_name` | Target | DNS zone |
|---|---|---|
| `blob`, `file`, `queue`, `table`, `dfs`, `web` | Storage account | `privatelink.<name>.core.windows.net` |
| `vault` | Key Vault | `privatelink.vaultcore.azure.net` |
| `redisenterprise` | Azure Managed Redis | `privatelink.redis.azure.net` |

Only these values are accepted. The platform derives the zone name from a fixed table, and for anything else it would fall back to `privatelink.<value>.core.windows.net` — wrong for every service that does not live under that suffix, leaving an endpoint whose DNS never resolves.

attributes.name: subnet_id
attributes.description: Full Azure resource ID (ARM ID) of the subnet that holds the endpoint's network interface, available as `duploai_network_baseline.azure_subnet_ids`. The subnet must allow private endpoints, and each endpoint consumes one private IP address from it.

attributes.name: azure_resource_group_name
attributes.description: Azure resource group the endpoint is created in. Defaults to the Azure resource group behind `resource_group_id`, which is almost always what you want — set it only to place the endpoint elsewhere.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description:
Tags applied to the private endpoint. The platform adds its own managed `duplocloud-ai-*` tags server-side; those are filtered out of state so only your tags are managed by Terraform.

Changing a tag replaces the endpoint, since the API has no update path at all.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type. Assigned by the platform when unset.

attributes.name: provisioner_version
attributes.description: Optional provisioner version. Left unset the API omits it, so this reads back empty rather than as an empty string.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs linking this private endpoint to a cloud provider account, inherited from the resource group.

attributes.name: private_endpoint_id
attributes.description: ID of this private endpoint, for reference by dependent resources.

attributes.name: unique_cloud_resource_id
attributes.description: Full Azure resource ID (ARM ID) of the private endpoint, as the platform records it on the resource itself. It is what the delete and refresh operations use to reach the endpoint.

attributes.name: private_endpoint_arm_id
attributes.description: Full Azure resource ID (ARM ID) of the private endpoint, as reported after creation.

attributes.name: private_ip_address
attributes.description: Private IP address assigned to the endpoint's network interface, and the address its DNS zone resolves the target's hostname to. Empty until Azure finishes provisioning, since it is read from the interface rather than chosen up front.

attributes.name: provisioning_state
attributes.description: Azure provisioning state of the endpoint, e.g. Succeeded or Creating, refreshed from Azure on each read.

attributes.name: dns_zone_group_provisioned
attributes.description: Whether the Private DNS zone group is attached. The endpoint only reaches Complete once this is true, so a Complete endpoint always resolves privately; while it is false the endpoint exists but the target's hostname still resolves publicly.

attributes.name: dns_zone_name
attributes.description: Private DNS zone attached to the endpoint, derived from `sub_resource_name` — e.g. `privatelink.blob.core.windows.net`.

attributes.name: dns_zone_arm_id
attributes.description: Full Azure resource ID (ARM ID) of the Private DNS zone created or reused for this endpoint. Zones are shared, so several endpoints for the same sub-resource type report the same value.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status of the private endpoint. Complete means the endpoint exists in Azure and its DNS zone group is attached.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the private endpoint was created (RFC 3339).
